这是一块真实的开放芯片版图。用“剥开最上层”向下看，细柱把相邻层连接起来。: This is a real open chip layout. Peel the top layer to look below. Thin pillars connect adjacent layers.
一直走到硅的表面: All the way to the silicon
四层金属和局部互连下面，粉色的栅跨过绿色的有源区。这些交叉处才是晶体管。: Below four metal layers and local interconnect, pink gates cross green active areas. The crossings form transistors.
用电场打开一条路: Open a path with an electric field
现在切换到平面 NMOS 示意。提高栅源电压会形成沟道；漏源之间还要有电压差，才: Now switch to a planar NMOS schematic. Raising gate-source voltage forms a channel; a drain-source voltage is also needed for sustained current.
栅极不接通电线，它用电场改变下面的硅。: A gate field changes the silicon below.
粉色的栅跨过绿色有源区，交叉处形成晶体管。: Pink gates cross green active areas to form transistors.
剥开层层连线，找到硅表面的晶体管。: Peel back the wiring to find transistors on the silicon.
这块电路用了四层金属，下面还有一层局部互连。: Four metal layers, with local interconnect underneath.
露出来的是有源区与栅，不是另一层金属线。: Active areas and gates are now exposed on the silicon.
栅源电压超过阈值，硅表面形成沟道。漏源电压推动电子从源极流向漏极。: Gate-source voltage exceeds the threshold, forming a channel. Drain-source voltage drives electrons from source to drain.
沟道已经形成；漏源电压为零，没有持续的净电流。: A channel exists, but with zero drain-source voltage there is no sustained net current.
提高栅源电压，让栅极下方形成一条可导电的沟道。: Raise gate-source voltage to form a conducting channel beneath the gate.
